attBesluta.text: I am well pleased with this tool organizer. It fit most of my Milwaukee tools in one small area now. Prior to purchasing this, they were scattered on shelves. At first glance, I didn't think it would nearly support the advertised weight max. But after assembly, i'm confident that it would. Assembly was simple, straight forward and all hardware was there. Ships in a box so small, I didn't think it was my shelves, but was. Happy with my purchase!
Trés bons pieds de table robustes de fabrication bien finie avec patins de réglage de niveau. Montés sous un grand plateau bois, l'ensemble forme une belle table de travail.
Au top, belles finitions, réglages simples et efficaces, pour le design ça dépend des goûts de chacun, mais le rendu est fidèle aux photos.

Belle gambe, solide, appensantite con la sabbia (dal rumore che fanno quando le giri su se stesse). colore ben fatto. Se le fissate (come me) ad un tavolino fatto di legno di 10mm non potete fissarle con le viti autofilettanti in dotazione, dovrete usare qualche cosa di grosso e corto da legno. I piedini sono ben fatti e di una gomma a quanto sembra resistente. Arrivate abbastanza velocemente avendo il maga di spedizione in europa e no spese dogana!!!

For the price, a very nice pair of legs. I combined it with a birch tabletop. Looks good. I didn't use the included screws. I put threaded inserts in the birchtabletop. I didn't find the little feet looked good, and the table was too high with them. They are absolutely not necessary if your floor is level, and the table looks much better without them. Overall, great legs, especially at this price.
Qualités et confort sont aux rendez-vous!
